svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / SETTINGS / CURRENCY
Each amount keeps its currency and a stored rate.
Displayed values use the stored rate and date. No live feed is requested.
Rate change requires a rerun. Results never mix old and new rates.
Amounts are converted for display only. Each source keeps its
Results are stale. Rerun to apply 1.05.
Every foreign amount stores its currency, a rate, and a rate date. Display converts with that stored pair.
Rate history is versioned with the run that used it, so a past result keeps its original conversion.
Display currency formats only. A cross-currency account converts contributions and withdrawals consistently.
Changing EUR/USD from 1.10 to 1.05 marks results stale and requires a rerun before the new value shows.
